html:
If you are arriving at Phu Quoc International Airport and staying in the Phu Quoc Centre Hotel Area, Vietlook Travel offers a one way private airport pick up service with a professional and experienced local driver.

This service is ideal for travelers who want a smooth arrival, fixed pricing, and a comfortable transfer directly from the airport to their hotel in the center of Phu Quoc.

Phu Quoc Airport to Centre Hotel Area Distance and Travel Time

The distance from Phu Quoc International Airport to the Phu Quoc Centre Hotel Area is approximately eight to ten kilometers, depending on the exact hotel location.

The transfer usually takes around fifteen to twenty five minutes by private car, depending on traffic conditions. Traveling by private car allows you to avoid waiting for taxis or shared shuttle services.

Meet and Greet Service at Phu Quoc International Airport

Upon arrival, our driver will be waiting at the airport arrival area with a welcome sign displaying your full name for easy recognition.

Please provide us with:

  • Flight number and landing time

  • Number of passengers

  • Hotel name in the Phu Quoc Centre Hotel Area

Our driver will assist you with luggage and escort you to the car for a direct transfer.

Comfortable and Flexible Airport Transfer

By booking the Phu Quoc airport pick up private car with Vietlook Travel, you will enjoy:

  • Door-to-door transfer service

  • Flexible pick up time based on your flight

  • Private and quiet journey without sharing

  • Fixed price with no hidden costs

Short stops can be arranged upon request if needed.

Professional Driver and Vehicle Options

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Clean and modern vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Experienced drivers familiar with Phu Quoc roads

  • Free baby seat available upon request

Vehicle options include five seat cars, seven seat cars, sixteen seat minibuses, and luxury Carnival vehicles.
